examples.title: Sequence summarization
examples.question: What are the key operative steps used to secure and divide the cystic duct and cystic artery?
examples.answer: Following stone removal and confirmation of the critical view of safety, definitive clips are applied to the cystic duct, clips are applied to the cystic artery, safe anatomy around Calot is reconfirmed, and the clipped cystic duct and cystic artery are divided.

examples.title: Sequence summarization
examples.question: What sequence of procedural steps is performed to achieve central ligation of the inferior mesenteric artery at its origin in this operation?
examples.answer: First, the sigmoid colon is mobilized off the left abdominal wall; then the sigmoid mesentery is mobilized via a medial approach to expose the vascular pedicle; finally, the inferior mesenteric artery is ligated at its origin.

examples.title: Sequence summarization
examples.question: Describe the workflow used to extract the tumor specimen safely and set up for anastomosis.
examples.answer: The surgeon enlarges the left lower quadrant incision to a small mini-laparotomy; places a wound protection sleeve to prevent tumor implantation; exteriorizes the tumor-bearing bowel segment; divides the bowel extracorporeally and separates the specimen; sends the specimen for pathologic assessment; secures the anvil to the proximal colon; closes the incision and re-establishes laparoscopy, then confirms the anvil reaches the rectal stump.
